tagline: Global manufacturer of electrical and utility solutions enabling critical infrastructure
hero_kpi_rationale: This KPI represents 63% of Hubbell's revenue, indicating the company's strong dependence and leadership in electrical grid solutions, an essential and growing sector generating $3.67 billion in 2025.
company_description: Hubbell Incorporated, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells electrical and utility solutions in the United States and internationally. It operates through two segments, Electrical Solutions and Utility Solutions. The Utility Solution segment offers critical components that allow the grid to transmit and distribute energy, as well as the communications and controls technologies, including utility transmission and distribution components, such as arresters, insulators, connectors, anchors, bushings, enclosures, cutouts, and switches; and solutions that serve the edge of the utility infrastructure comprising smart meters, communications systems, and protection and control devices. It sells its products under various brands and/or trademarks to the electrical distribution, substation and transmission markets, as well as markets for grid protection and controls, utility meters and advanced metering infrastructure and telecom and gas distribution markets. kpis.name: Utility Solutions Segment Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated by the electrical grid solutions business.
kpis.description: This segment represents the majority of the company's revenue, focused on critical components for energy transmission and distribution. In 2025, it accounted for 63% of consolidated revenue.

kpis.name: Electrical Solutions Segment Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated by electrical solutions for buildings and industrial applications.
kpis.description: This segment covers electrical products for non-residential, telecom, and other infrastructure markets. Represented 37% of consolidated revenue in 2025.
kpis.signal: Contributes to diversification and balanced growth.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue remaining after deducting cost of goods sold.
kpis.description: Gross margin indicates production efficiency and material cost management. In 2025, it reached 35.3%, up from 33.9% in 2024.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue remaining after deducting operating expenses.
kpis.description: Operating margin reflects the company's overall performance before interest and taxes. In 2025, it increased to 20.7% from 19.4% in 2024.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Total amount spent on tangible and intangible fixed assets.
kpis.description: Capital expenditures in 2025 support production network optimization, automation, and productivity initiatives.

kpis.name: Total Headcount
kpis.description: Hubbell employed approximately 18,000 individuals globally as of December 31, 2025, reflecting the company's overall operational scale.
kpis.signal: Operational stability of the talent base.

kpis.name: Operating Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Cash generated from the company's core operating activities.
kpis.description: Operating cash flow of $1,029.8 million in 2025 indicates a strong and growing ability to generate cash from operations, up 3.9% compared to 2024.

kpis.name: Free Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Cash remaining after deducting capital expenditures.
kpis.description: Free cash flow of $874.7 million in 2025 (up 7.9%) can be used for debt repayment, dividends ($286.6 million), share repurchases ($225.0 million), or acquisitions ($958.3 million).
kpis.signal: Increased financial flexibility and capital allocation capacity.

kpis.name: Dividend per Share
kpis.description: Annual dividend per share paid, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last seven fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of $1.42 in the latest year.

kpis.name: Capital Returned (Dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last four fiscal years reported.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of $0.287 billion in the latest year.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.description: Payout Ratio = Dividends Paid / Net Income, calculated over the last four fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Portion of net income distributed as dividends: 32.3% in the latest year.

kpis.name: Acquisition Investments
kpis.explanation: Amount invested in acquiring other companies in 2025.
kpis.description: Hubbell invested $958.3 million in acquisitions in 2025 to acquire assets that extend its capabilities, broaden its product offerings, and provide competitive opportunities in key and adjacent markets.
kpis.signal: Active external growth strategy in high-potential markets.

kpis.name: Share Repurchases
kpis.explanation: Amount used to repurchase the company's shares.
kpis.description: The company repurchased $225.0 million of shares in 2025, reflecting a balanced capital return policy alongside acquisition investments and dividends.

kpis.name: Dividends Paid
kpis.explanation: Total amount of dividends distributed to shareholders.
kpis.description: Dividends paid in 2025 reached $286.6 million, up 7.2% from 2024, demonstrating Hubbell's ongoing commitment to capital return.

kpis.name: Earnings per Share
kpis.explanation: Net income divided by the weighted average number of diluted shares for the fiscal year. Measures the company's ability to generate earnings per share: basis for Payout Ratio calculation (DPS / EPS).
kpis.description: Five-year history (2021-2025). Source: yfinance income statement (Diluted EPS).
